comment: ORCHID literature values, Version 1, machine-extracted. Evidence class: experimental. ORCHID observation ids (orchid-literature `id`, one per value, in value order): ORC-56OXWXS2EA
orchid_temperature_note: temperature from the published records (page-checked correction of the stored temperature)

orchid_uncertainty.weight_rule: dataset weight = ESPEI experimental default sigma_HM = 500 J/mol / median sigma of the dataset's values (printed sigma; assumed default where none was printed); ESPEI 0.9.1 equilibrium data take one weight per dataset

printed.interval: printed sigma combined in quadrature with |dx| x local hull slope: the source measured the historical formula of this phase (page-checked; printed sigma in the record's uncertainty_stored)
printed.note: sqrt(1.900^2 + (|dx| 0.0333 x slope 49.74 kJ/mol per unit x)^2): printed sigma and the offset between Cu4Zr (measured, x_Zr 0.2000) and Cu5Zr (x_Zr 0.1667); slope = median |slope| of the 298.15 K lower hull segment in nine Cu-Zr assessments (open-tdb sgte-binary CuZr-*.tdb)

orchid_weight_floor.rule: optional minimum-sigma policy (E6): sigma_eff = max(sigma, sigma_floor) with sigma_floor = ESPEI's experimental default for the property (500 J/mol for enthalpies and for the chemical potential of activities, 0.2 J/mol/K for entropies and heat capacities); suggested_weight = min(weight, 1). The printed sigma is unchanged (orchid_uncertainty); use suggested_weight when printed sigmas are much smaller than the scatter between sources (e.g. formation enthalpies printed with +-80 J/mol-atom while other measurements differ by 1-2 kJ/mol-atom)

endmember.reference: SER phases of the TDB's ELEMENT lines (ESPEI _FORM convention); the value's printed reference state names the same phases (or none)
